data.body: Implementation complete in worktree. not_a_bug + escalated added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES; new REPLACEMENT_SATISFIES_REASON_CLASSES={not_a_bug,escalated} lets a live replacement link satisfy the requirement (checked FIRST in verdict() and in the new close_disposition.reason_refusal shared by txn.close_class_refusal, which now takes optional ticket_id/tracker). Neither reason nor replacement -> write-side refusal naming both doors; never falls through to the completion verifier. ESCALATED DECISION: reason-required same as not_a_bug (identical structural problem — no in-repo defect fixed, verifier unpassable); replacement-preferred preserved via check order; --reason names where the work was escalated to. 31 new tests in tests/unit/commands/test_close_disposition.py; 738a + fc20 suites updated for the new set membership and stay green (99 passed). make lint + make typecheck clean. Docs: ticket-model.md, transition help text, cli-reference regenerated.
